name: fact_checker
description: Cross-references a specific factual claim against multiple authoritative sources to verify its accuracy. Use this tool to verify numerical data, financial figures, company facts, or any claim before including it in a research report. Returns verification status, supporting evidence from each source checked, and an overall confidence score (0-1).

claim.description: The specific factual claim to verify (e.g., 'Apple revenue in Q3 2024 was $85.8 billion')

sources.description: Optional list of source tools to check against. Defaults to ['financial_data_api', 'sec_filing_search', 'web_search']
